relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Investment requests and approved funding conditions; no transfer of cash is modeled.

relations.name: Scope the technology case
relations.description: The partner supplies thesis assumptions and decision priorities.

relations.name: Present technology recommendation
relations.description: The team supplies the concise thesis, evidence, and open conditions.

relations.name: Communicate approved technology conditions
relations.description: Investment conditions inform company funding and ownership priorities; company budgets retain their own approvals.

relations.name: Accept the diligence handoff
relations.description: The CTO receives finding context and accepts company-owned next decisions.

relations.name: Agree company technology outcomes
relations.description: CEO and CTO align priorities, capacity, investment, and outcome tests.

relations.name: Report company progress
relations.description: The CTO reports agreed outcomes and asks for decisions while keeping coaching notes private.

relations.name: Review technology value and exposure
relations.description: Management provides company outcome evidence and material exceptions.

relations.name: Return oversight decisions
relations.description: The board gives decisions and follow-up conditions without taking over execution.

relations.name: Provide approved technology evidence
relations.description: The CTO supplies reviewed company readiness evidence through authorized disclosure.

relations.name: Explain the technology exit story
relations.description: The exit team shares substantiated claims and unresolved buyer concerns.

relations.name: Share approved operating capability evidence
relations.description: The manager shares qualified, permissioned operating evidence through its investor-reporting process.

relations.name: Request capability evidence
relations.description: Allocator questions inform an approved response; they do not grant access to raw company or coaching data.
